description: This file provides utility functions for MIME type handling, including checking if a MIME type is JSON or Textual, and retrieving MIME types based on file extensions. It also contains a map of file extensions to MIME types.

methods.name: isJsonMimeType
methods.description: Checks if the provided MIME type string matches common JSON MIME types.

methods.name: isTextualMimeType
methods.description: Checks if the provided MIME type string matches common Textual MIME types.

methods.name: getMimeTypeForPath
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given file path based on its extension, or null if unknown.
